plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, English - Literary Studies Emphasis BA/BS graduation plan text PDF (program awarded as BA/BS; the published plan includes the BA foreign-language sequence). Semester totals as printed: 16 / 16 / 16 / 17 / 15 / 15 / 13 / 12 = 120, matching the printed 'Total Hours 120'. ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN) and ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN) verified against the official 2025-2026 program texts. All other ENGL course slots (ENGL 1410, 2400/2500, 2410/2510, 2600, 3030, 320x, 321x, 3220, 3230, 326x-328x, 3400, 3510, 3600, 3810, 4700) and 'Foreign Language (Beginning I/II, Intermediate I/II)' are choice placeholders (credits as printed); titles not shown in the graduation plan — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. 'ENGL 320x Genre Studies', 'ENGL 321x Period/Topic Studies', 'ENGL 326x-328x Major Authors' are wildcard choice slots as printed. The 4th-Year Fall 'General Elective' with no printed hours is modeled as 1 credit so the semester sums to the printed 13. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
